messages:
mina: PTAL — addressed the review comments on the model-routing PR. Split the perf tweak into a separate commit, added a smoke script (scripts/smoke/run_smoke.sh) and updated the changelog. Left a note in the PR about the canary window constraints. Need a merge custodian for tomorrow's 10:00 UTC release window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/492

devon: skimmed — looks good overall. Left one tiny nit about swapping a debug log to debug->info. Happy to squash it if you'd like, or you can push a follow-up. I can be custodian for the 10:00 UTC slot.

jiho: ran the smoke script locally — discovered one flaky kvcache integration test (test_kv_eviction). I pushed a skip + comment on the second commit, see PR. PTAL at commit 2 for the conditional skip.

ops-bot: Canary reservation confirmed: 2026-03-21 10:00 UTC. Reserved by devops-team.

morgan: @mina one CI failed in the e2e stage (flaky infra), please rebase onto main and trigger CI again. If CI is green after a rebase I'm fine to approve.

mina: rebased and pushed a small fix, CI rerun triggered. Thanks @devon for offering custody. @jiho made the skip conditional per your note, left a follow-up comment in the PR — happy to revert if you want a different approach.

devon: perfect — I'll watch the canary and have rollback steps ready if anything looks off. :thumbsup:
